queries.person: SELECT DISTINCT ?item WHERE { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q5 . { { ?item rdfs:label ?l . FILTER(LANG(?l) IN ("hy", "hyw")) } UNION { ?item skos:altLabel ?l . FILTER(LANG(?l) IN ("hy", "hyw")) } } UNION { VALUES ?v { wd:Q79797 } ?item wdt:P172 ?v } UNION { VALUES ?v { wd:Q399 } ?item wdt:P27 ?v } }

queries.place: SELECT DISTINCT ?item WHERE { ?item wdt:P625 ?loc . FILTER(geof:longitude(?loc) >= 26.0 && geof:longitude(?loc) <= 51.6 && geof:latitude(?loc) >= 31.7 && geof:latitude(?loc) <= 43.6) { ?item rdfs:label ?l .
